self_assessment: Added db.mget to all three adapters (redis via client.mget; mongo via $in on _key; postgres via ANY($1::TEXT[]) joining legacy_object_live/legacy_string) - each preserves input key order and returns null for missing keys. Confirmation validity now comes from an expires timestamp stored in confirm:<code> rather than DB TTL: isValidationPending checks Date.now() < expires (and matches email when given), getValidationExpiry derives remaining ms from it, canSendValidation falls back to Date.now() when no TTL. Added user.email.getEmailForValidation(uid) which prefers user:<uid>.email then falls back to the confirm object's email when its uid matches. ACP loadUserInfo gained getConfirmObjs() using db.mget + db.getObjects and sets email:pending / email:expired per user (surfaced in users.tpl); validateEmail and sendValidationEmail now resolve the email via getEmailForValidation (validate also persists it); deleteAccount calls User.email.expireValidation. Verified: node --check passes on every changed file and the mget order/null-fill mapping was exercised directly. NodeBB's suite needs a live redis/mongo instance, so it could not be run here.
